build_model_nextn: build a LongcatFlashForCausalLMNextN model for speculative next-n token generation with quantization config
create_decoder_layer: create a LongcatFlashDenseDecoderLayer with attention MLA, MLP, and layer communicator for inference
load_model_weights: load model weights from a checkpoint with fused q_a and kv_a projection support for nextn model

post_load_weights: post-process loaded weights with requantization and scale adjustments for deepgemm compatibility
